source_title: 탱커없다길래 가서 폐광에서 길따라 몹잡는데 냥꾼이
subtitle: 죽음의 폐광 착한 전탱 vs 훈수 냥꾼 — '피곤해서 탱은 싫은데요?'

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
탱커 없다길래
방패 들고 왔어!
폐광 바로 가자~
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder (OTS) diagonal shot from behind the Night Elf Priest's silver cowl in foreground-right, looking at the Orc Warrior tank in foreground-left standing beside a wooden minecart on iron rails. The Orc Warrior cheerfully presents her sturdy round iron shield and 1H broadsword, beaming with proud hero enthusiasm and a bright toothy grin. Lower two-thirds framing, top 35% pure white (#FFFFFF) headroom. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle shot looking up at the Dwarf Hunter girl standing on the right half, leaning against her wooden blunderbuss like a cane with a smug, patronizing smirk and half-closed eyes. She wags an index finger sideways in a lecturing gesture with little sweatdrop annoyance lines. Cleanly positioned on the right half, leaving generous pure white (#FFFFFF) space on the left 48% for dialogue bubble. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
그렇게 잘 아시면
냥꾼님이 탱커
하시면 되겠네요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dutch-tilt slapstick action camera with a tilted diagonal composition. Orc Warrior tank steps forward aggressively, thrusting her sturdy round shield right into Dwarf Hunter's face with furious sharp teeth and anime anger vein popping, 1H sword held low. Dwarf Hunter stumbles backward in shock, hands flying up. Lower two-thirds framing, top 35% pure white (#FFFFFF) headroom. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile 90-degree action shot of the Dwarf Hunter girl on the right half, shrugging with both palms turned up in the air, puffing her cheeks with a nonchalant cheeky face, eyes rolling upward. Her blunderbuss is slung across her back, hands completely free. Positioned cleanly on the right half, leaving generous pure white (#FFFFFF) space on the left 48% for dialogue bubble. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.

High-angle shot looking down at the Orc Warrior tank in a signature comedic freeze-frame, completely wordless. Completely dumbfounded and exasperated, her 1H sword slips from her fingers, she drops her sturdy shield onto the ground with a heavy clatter, her jaw dropping open with empty white hollow eyes and dark purple vertical gloom lines over her forehead. Centered dramatic framing filling ~78% of canvas height. 100% pure solid #FFFFFF white borderless background, zero text, zero UI.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
네~ 그럼 냥꾼님도
깔끔하게 스킵하고
출발할게요~
cuts.visual_prompt: Back-view shot seen from behind of the Night Elf Priest and Orc Warrior tank marching away together toward the dungeon door on the left, turning their backs to the Dwarf Hunter. The Priest gives a polite wave goodbye over her shoulder with a sweet, lethal smile, while Dwarf Hunter in the background is shown being kicked out in a cartoon flying boot puff!
